purpose: Public-facing descriptions only. Pricing, availability and entitlement remain server-authoritative.

academic_consult_60.title: Specialist academic consultation
academic_consult_60.fit: For a defined academic decision requiring individual analysis and professional guidance.
academic_consult_60.outcome: A 60-minute analytical session to clarify the issue, options and next step.
academic_consult_60.boundary: Not a substitute for long-term follow-up or comprehensive talent assessment.

student_parent_90.title: Student and parent consultation
student_parent_90.fit: For an educational decision that benefits from both the student’s and parent’s participation.
student_parent_90.outcome: A 90-minute joint session to examine evidence, concerns and the decision pathway.
student_parent_90.boundary: Not designed for family conflict intervention or clinical concerns.

konkur_consult_60.title: University entrance examination consultation (Konkur)
konkur_consult_60.fit: For focused decisions about Konkur preparation, study planning or changing course.
konkur_consult_60.outcome: A 60-minute session focused on the current issue and practical next steps.
konkur_consult_60.boundary: No examination rank or result is guaranteed.

konkur_month.title: One-month Konkur guidance programme
konkur_month.fit: For students seeking structured guidance over one month.
konkur_month.outcome: An individual one-month guidance plan with an approach to reviewing progress.
konkur_month.boundary: The number and format of follow-ups are agreed before final booking.

transcript_analysis.title: Academic transcript and pathway analysis
transcript_analysis.fit: For turning academic record evidence into an understandable educational decision.
transcript_analysis.outcome: A review of strengths and constraints reflected in the transcript, with potential options.
transcript_analysis.boundary: A transcript alone cannot replace exploration of interests, context and goals.

field_selection_standard.title: Standard university major selection
field_selection_standard.fit: For applicants who need systematic, defensible priorities among programme and university choices.
field_selection_standard.outcome: A structured development and review of preferences grounded in the applicant’s verified information.
field_selection_standard.boundary: Admission is not guaranteed; official capacity and admission rules apply.

field_selection_comprehensive.title: Comprehensive university major selection
field_selection_comprehensive.fit: For applicants navigating competing pathways, constraints or priorities requiring deeper analysis.
field_selection_comprehensive.outcome: A more detailed evaluation of alternatives and final preference ordering informed by individual evidence.
field_selection_comprehensive.boundary: The final decision remains with the applicant and family; guidance does not replace their agency.

talent_initial.title: Initial specialist talent assessment
talent_initial.fit: For beginning a multi-source review of strengths and development potential before major decisions.
talent_initial.outcome: An initial evidence profile and identification of questions needing further examination.
talent_initial.boundary: No definitive talent label, IQ designation or clinical diagnosis is produced.

golden_talent_comprehensive.title: Golden Talent — comprehensive assessment and pathway
golden_talent_comprehensive.fit: For families seeking a multi-source, development-oriented approach beyond one test.
golden_talent_comprehensive.outcome: Synthesis of available Golden Talent evidence and a provisional development pathway.
golden_talent_comprehensive.boundary: No Total Talent Score or definitive career or degree prescription is provided.

golden_talent_premium.title: Golden Talent — assessment, parent session and pathway report
golden_talent_premium.fit: For cases requiring a comprehensive review, a parent consultation and a pathway report.
golden_talent_premium.outcome: A comprehensive Golden Talent review, parent session and pathway report within verified evidence limits.
golden_talent_premium.boundary: The report is neither a certain forecast of the future nor a psychological diagnosis.

teacher_consult_60.title: Teacher consultation: materials, teaching and assessment
teacher_consult_60.fit: For educators with a specific challenge in teaching, learning materials or assessment.
teacher_consult_60.outcome: A 60-minute problem analysis with viable professional options.
teacher_consult_60.boundary: Full course design or a whole-institution project is outside this session.

teacher_dev_90.title: Educator professional development session
teacher_dev_90.fit: For educators seeking deeper analysis of a professional issue and planning for growth.
teacher_dev_90.outcome: A 90-minute discussion grounded in evidence, professional judgement and next steps.
teacher_dev_90.boundary: No formal certification or institutional promotion is guaranteed.

manuscript_diagnostic.title: Manuscript diagnostic review, up to 7,000 words
manuscript_diagnostic.fit: For manuscripts of up to 7,000 words needing a diagnosis of key weaknesses before submission or revision.
manuscript_diagnostic.outcome: A diagnostic review accompanied by a prioritised revision report.
manuscript_diagnostic.boundary: Excludes ghostwriting, fabricated data and guarantees of journal acceptance.

academic_editing.title: Academic English editing, up to 5,000 words
academic_editing.fit: For developed academic manuscripts of up to 5,000 words that need English-language refinement.
academic_editing.outcome: An edited version focused on clarity, linguistic accuracy and scholarly expression.
academic_editing.boundary: Language editing does not substitute for research redesign or writing original scholarship on the author's behalf.

research_consult_60.title: Research consultation
research_consult_60.fit: For researchers with a defined question about design, methods, interpretation or argumentation.
research_consult_60.outcome: A 60-minute analysis of the research issue and the next decision.
research_consult_60.boundary: The adviser does not generate data or undertake the research for the client.

journal_strategy.title: Journal selection and publication strategy
journal_strategy.fit: For manuscripts requiring an informed assessment of journal fit and submission strategy.
journal_strategy.outcome: Analysis of suitability and publication options informed by topic, scope and manuscript readiness.
journal_strategy.boundary: No journal placement or acceptance is guaranteed.

reviewer_response.title: Reviewer-response support, up to 20 comments
reviewer_response.fit: For authors responding to up to 20 reviewer comments and seeking a systematic scholarly response.
reviewer_response.outcome: Review of the comments and assistance structuring evidence-based responses.
reviewer_response.boundary: The author remains responsible for the accuracy of revisions and the final scientific response.

academic_cv.title: Academic CV and applications strategy
academic_cv.fit: For scholars reviewing their CV and application approach for a specific opportunity.
academic_cv.outcome: A review of CV structure and presentation of evidence aligned with the target role.
academic_cv.boundary: No admission, interview invitation or employment is guaranteed.

academic_interview_90.title: Academic or faculty interview preparation
academic_interview_90.fit: For candidates preparing for a defined academic or faculty recruitment interview.
academic_interview_90.outcome: A structured 90-minute session informed by the role, background and likely questions.
academic_interview_90.boundary: Recruitment and selection outcomes cannot be guaranteed.

organization_consult_90.title: School and organisational education consultation
organization_consult_90.fit: For a school or organisation needing to define an educational problem and an initial course of action.
organization_consult_90.outcome: A 90-minute examination of the challenge, stakeholders and possible actions.
organization_consult_90.boundary: Full project delivery, field evaluation and workshops are priced separately.

specialist_workshop_120.title: Specialist online workshop, up to two hours
specialist_workshop_120.fit: For schools, organisations and professional groups with a defined topic and audience.
specialist_workshop_120.outcome: An online specialist workshop of up to two hours on the agreed topic.
specialist_workshop_120.boundary: Multi-session course design, institutional evaluation or bespoke materials are outside this fee.
